name: Psychic Command
body:
School enchantment (compulsion) [mind-affecting]; Level medium 2, mesmerist 2, occultist 2, psychic 2; Focus hand 2

DESCRIPTION

As command, except you issue the command directly into the target’s mind, forgoing the need for a verbal order.

Psychic Command, Greater

School enchantment (compulsion) [mind-affecting]; Level mesmerist 5, occultist 6, psychic 6; Focus hand 5

DESCRIPTION

As greater command, except you issue the command directly into the targets’ mind, forgoing the need for a verbal order.
